# Publishable workspace crates, in dependency (topological) order.
#
# Source of truth for release crate order:
#   .github/workflows/tag-publish.yml passes this file to the shared workspace release workflow.
#   soltiHQ/actions validates the list and publishes crates sequentially.
#
# Dependency layout - required + optional (because publish runs with `--all-features`):
#   solti-model       - no internal deps
#   solti-tls         - no internal deps
#   solti-observe     - optional: solti-model, taskvisor
#   solti-runner      - solti-model, taskvisor (base)
#   solti-chain       - solti-model, solti-runner, taskvisor
#   solti-exec        - optional: solti-model, solti-runner, taskvisor (`subprocess` feature)
#   solti-core        - solti-model, solti-runner, taskvisor (`controller` feature)
#   solti-api         - solti-model; optional: solti-core (`core-adapter`),
#                       solti-tls (`grpc-tls`)
#   solti-discover    - optional: solti-model, taskvisor (transport features),
#                       solti-tls (`tls` feature)
#   solti-prometheus  - optional: solti-runner, taskvisor (default features), solti-model,
#                       solti-core, solti-api, solti-discover
#   solti             - optional umbrella over every SDK crate; publish last
#
# When adding a publishable crate, insert it at its correct topological position.
# Release publication depends on this order.

solti-model
solti-tls
solti-observe
solti-runner
solti-chain
solti-exec
solti-core
solti-api
solti-discover
solti-prometheus
solti
